- Roasted sweet potato cubes (including the small pieces on the right)

**STEP 7 - Energy:**

- Bacon: 10 g × 540 kcal/100 g ≈ 54 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A partly covered dinner plate with these three components should weigh roughly 150–200 g. The cheese is the main uncertainty: if it is cottage cheese or ricotta instead of feta, the energy would be closer to 150–200 kcal.
